original.target_description: Study 1: IPD-MD game, comparison of within-group pool W contributions with versus without intragroup communication; group-level analysis, printed t(29).

n.sample_role: 3-person groups, analytic units in the two IPD-MD communication conditions (20 groups per condition).
n.exclusions: No analytic exclusions reported in the inspected Method/Results. Other two IPD conditions are outside this within-IPD-MD comparison. Supplementary all-female groups mentioned in footnote 2 are separate from the main male-student experiment.

notes: Only n_o and es_value_o are assigned. Source identity matches Halevy, Bornstein, and Sagiv (2008), title and pp. 405–411. Analytic N derivation: 20 IPD-MD/no-communication groups + 20 IPD-MD/communication groups = 40 groups; groups are explicitly the analysis units. Each contains three participants, but the recorded N is groups, not participants. All four conditions together are not the target sample. The printed t has df 29; this is retained literally and no N is inferred from df. Source does not explain the df relative to group counts. The identified test concerns communication increasing pool W contributions from 47% to 68%; it is distinct from overall W-or-B contribution tests and the pool-B footnote test. Same-test p is printed as p 5 .010 (canonical extraction uses 5 for the equals sign), but p_o is unassigned and left a placeholder. No PDF path was supplied; no PDF acquisition/render performed.
